title: I just made a website that hosts everyone's AI games completely free - no catch, and full credit to all developers with links to their socials/other games. Even offer GitHub hosting
author: W3103_
selftext:
Currently hosting over 200 of the best around (and a few stinkers of my own) and always looking for more - have a play and send me your good games at [slopville.com](http://slopville.com) 

Even if it's on github I can host it in browser on the site - all game links direct to your website directly so you also get traffic as well as people playing the game you made

No commercial services or anything being offered, just trying to get the spotlight on more devs. Free site, not even ads are hosted so I can't stress enough I have nothing to gain, I just want one place where we can all play our games! 

thanks guys, 

joe @ slopville  (mods let this stay up i beg)
